title: Chapter 103: True Recognition
content:
Chapter 103: True Recognition

The evil god camp has a lot of weapons and equipment stored in it. They must have never thought that they would lose this battle. Many of these combat supplies were prepared for the post-war war.

Wu Qing took out these weapons and equipment as rewards and distributed them to various territories of the alliance, which can quickly enhance the strength of each territory. When they are stronger, the alliance will have capable combat troops, instead of like now, Only supported by the Zerg.

The territories that have joined the alliance have developed rapidly, making the alliance attractive and attracting more territories to join.

The alliance has become stronger. This truly local force will become a huge shield for Wu Qing and the Zerg, standing in front of Wu Qing and the Zerg to resist the dangers that violate the rules.

This time, the alliance contribution of many territories was not enough, and the weapons and equipment that could be allocated were extremely limited. Wu Qing planned to take out all the unused weapons and equipment after a period of time and trade them within the alliance in exchange for what the Daxia Territory needed. supplies.

Sure enough, when they saw the list of reward materials that Wu Qing brought out, all the lords in the alliance beamed with joy. Even the five lords Meng, Hu Wei, Shi Gan, Yu Chong and Bai Yan looked very happy.

In this world, resource extraction is relatively difficult, and the value of weapons and equipment is quite high.

As long as you have enough weapons and equipment, it is not difficult to expand the army. If you take any one of the many races in this world, their physical fitness and combat experience can be comparable to ordinary soldiers.

As long as they have weapons and equipment and a little training, they are qualified soldiers.

Nowadays, the main components of many territorial armies are unarmored militiamen. These militiamen have no armor, carry simple weapons, and are vulnerable to a blow.

With sophisticated weapons and equipment, these militiamen can become elite warriors after training.

"Wu Qing! We won't say more if we are grateful!"

"We all see what you and the Zerg have done for the alliance!"

"From now on in the alliance, whoever dares to disrespect you and the Zerg! I will be the first to make him look good!"

Meng solemnly stated his stance to Wu Qing, which was a clear statement that the alliance would be dominated by Wu Qing and the Zerg in the future.

"Lord Fierce is right! Without you and the Zerg, there would be no alliance today!"

"It is you who set an example and made everyone feel what respect means!"

"No matter how the alliance develops in the future, we will always be supporters of you and the Zerg!"

Another lord came out to express his position.

Wu Qing saw that most of the lords were trying to express their sincerity, and immediately reached out to stop them.

It is impossible for all the lords here to be absolutely convinced by Wu Qing and the Zerg in such a short period of time. I can only say that Meng's rhythm is too good.

Wu Qing didn't need this kind of verbal statement that he didn't know whether it was sincere or false. If he didn't stop it and let the situation continue to develop like this, it might be counterproductive and create a gap between Wu Qing and most of the lords in the alliance.

Wu Qing knew that Meng was sincere in his statement and had no other bad intentions. However, the origins of the lords in this alliance were indeed complicated. Even Hu Wei, Shi Gan, Yu Chong and Bai Yan expressed their full support for Wu at this time. Qing and Wu Qing were not sure of their true thoughts.

However, it doesn't matter. Even if the alliance is just a combination of interests, there will be no practical difference between Wu Qing and the Zerg. As long as the alliance continues to develop under the leadership of the Zerg, Wu Qing's purpose Even if it is achieved.

Of course, in the end, the entire alliance can really unite as one and collectively support Wu Qing and the Zerg. This result is definitely the best. Wu Qing is happy to see the result and will work hard in this direction.

"Don't forget the purpose of establishing an alliance. Our purpose is to form an alliance to protect ourselves and watch each other!"

"Now that the Zerg are the strongest in the alliance, it is appropriate to pay more as much as possible."

"If everyone engages in this kind of formalism, the nature of the alliance will change. What we should support is the right thing, not a certain person!"

Wu Qing said to everyone seriously.

"I didn't think well and made a bad start!"

Meng Ye suddenly realized something was wrong and immediately admitted his mistake.

As soon as Wu Qing said this, lords like Hu Wei truly recognized him from the bottom of their hearts.

“Lord Wu Qing’s noble character makes Hu ashamed!”

"From now on, Hu and Hu Jiaqiu will put the interests of the alliance first and do their best for the development of the alliance!"

Hu Wei changed his approach and was the first to express his stance.

"I, the Stone Clan, have no other abilities. If any of the weapons and equipment you have received are inappropriate, take them over and I, the Stone Clan, will help you change them!"

"From now on, all the alliance's weapons and equipment building tasks can be left to us!"

Shi Gan expressed his stance in his own way.

"The Yu tribe only has sharp arrows in their hands! Go into battle and kill the enemy! Do your duty!"

Yu Chong said with a smile.

"I, the white wolf, don't have many original qualities! I just have many wolf cubs! I'm not afraid of death!"

Bai Yan said coldly.

"..."

One by one, the lords said something in their own way, and they all spoke sincerely!

Wu Qing likes the atmosphere in the alliance very much. After taking turns to express his position like today, the cohesion of the alliance will be greatly enhanced.

The relationship between the various territories of the alliance will also be further deepened. When within the larger framework of the alliance, complementary advantages and mutual support between the territories become the norm, territorial barriers in the alliance will slowly be eliminated.

When conditions are ripe, each territory in the alliance will become a city, and the distinction between territories will not be so obvious.

"Haha, good! With everyone's words, I believe that the development and growth of the alliance is just around the corner!"

"Everyone go back and develop the territory well! It won't be long before we can counterattack the territory of the evil god camp!"

The idea of forming an alliance was first proposed by Meng. Seeing that the relationship between the various territories in the alliance has become closer, Meng feels happy from the bottom of his heart.

The lords present are also in a good mood. In this world where survival is difficult, it is difficult to have a relaxed environment like the alliance, allowing everyone to speak freely from the heart!

Next to it is the sphere of influence of the Tengu clan. Everyone knows what kind of treatment the lords of the territory who are attached to them are.

The lords who are attached to the Tengu clan are equivalent to higher-level slaves. Their fate is controlled by people and they have no dignity.

The alliance is hard-won, so we should cherish it!

This is what everyone thinks at the moment.

"You can go to Daxia to claim the reward materials at any time. Due to time constraints, we will not discuss the specific distribution now."

"Next, we have another very important thing to do!"

"The name of this city has been chosen, and the Tengu tribe's army is stationed within the city. It's time for them to leave!"

Wu Qing spoke up and ended the meeting of the alliance lords. Next, he had to take action and do things.
